name: Nutshell
summary: CRM and email marketing for small businesses.

flows.title: Import companies, people and leads from a CSV
steps: Before you start, create any tags and company types the file uses, and if you assign records to team members, make sure their usernames in Nutshell match the names in the file exactly.
Go to Settings > Data > Import, click Click to upload, select your CSV file and click Continue.

On the mapping step, check every column: a green checkmark means Nutshell matched it, and a column showing Don't import can be mapped to an existing field or skipped. For a column that matches no field, use its Match to dropdown to create a custom field.

On the Review page, choose how existing records are matched — Also match companies by name, and Update existing people matched by full name, email address, or either — and toggle Create leads from this import if you want a lead for each company or person imported.
Click Begin import, then View status to follow it on the Import status page. The Errors tab lists any rows that failed, so you can fix them and re-import.

flows.title: Share a synced email with your team
steps: Open your personal inbox in Nutshell, where emails from mail sync appear. Only you can see your inbox.
Find the email: a message that is not shared with your team has a dashed line around it.

Click Share with everyone on the email. It becomes visible to your team on the timelines of the person, company and lead it belongs to, and Nutshell creates people for a sender or recipient who is not in Nutshell yet.
